notes: Posted under Norman Horn's byline, but the post says the deck was played by his brother Dustin Horn, who won the Missouri State Championship with it undefeated (beating Hunt Down three times, including the 2nd- and 3rd-place players); credited to Dustin Horn. Norman Horn already has a wiki page.

Only the Objective is posted as a starting card. Heading For The Medical Frigate is listed under Interrupts and the strategy says 'You will almost always start Strike Planning, Battle Plan, and YISYW', so it is the starting interrupt; no single starting Effect is named, so starting.effect is left empty. Total 60 as published.
Posted 'Luke wlightsaber' x2 and 'Obi wlightsaber' (in the Characters section) dested Luke With Lightsaber and Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia wblaster' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle.

Posted 'Chewbacca' dested the A New Hope Chewbacca (the strategy says 'ANH Chewbacca'); 'General Crix Madeen' dested General Crix Madine; 'Pucimer Thryss' dested Pucumir Thryss; 'Run Luke Run' dested Run Luke, Run!.
Posted 'Bespin Cloud City' and 'CC ...' sites dested Bespin: Cloud City and the Cloud City sites (Guest Quarters, Core Tunnel, West Gallery, Carbonite Chamber).
Path Of Least Resistance is posted both as the combo (x2) and singly (x1); both rows are kept as published.
player_note: The post says Dustin Horn won the 2001 Missouri State Championship undefeated with this deck; his brother Norman Horn posted it because Dustin was not on DeckTech.
